summary: Frontend-only re-brand verification for Hi Tours (Tourlane clone). Verified hero headline text, no overlap between hero-search-form and hero-collage at 1440/905/390, font application (Bricolage Grotesque for headings, Inter for body, Instrument Sans for buttons/labels), blue-vs-orange color balance, and regression of interactive flows (showcase/destination tabs, carousel next, newsletter submit). All primary acceptance criteria pass.

detailed_verifications.hero_title_exact_text: Discover and book amazing customized honeymoons and holidays. (verified at 1440, 905, 390)

colors.comparison_header_bg: selector on thead returned null - style likely on <th> inside; visual scan shows Ink header. Not a bug, just selector limitation in scan.
colors.orange_element_scan: 21 hits at each width. All are SVG icons (MapPin in search bars, Mail icon, bullet check icons) plus one <span class='...bg-accent'> for active showcase tab underline. Matches spec exactly - no stray orange text/borders/buttons.
orange_locations_identified: other decorative check/bullet SVGs matching spec

regression.sections_rendered_visually: All sections present in DOM/visible in screenshot (hero, trust-bar, features, ambassadors, comparison, moments, steps, showcase, adventure, experts, testimonials, destinations, newsletter, footer). Only some section wrappers lack top-level data-testid (see minor code review note).
regression.destination_tabs_switch: OK (10 tabs, click works, screenshot shows Africa content)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor testability gap: some top-level section wrappers lack data-testid (ambassadors, adventure-cta, experts, testimonials, destinations, footer). Their inner content renders correctly but adding wrapper data-testid would improve future test resilience.
Comparison table header background is applied at <th> level; adding a data-testid on the thead/tr would help automated color assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 confirmed the re-brand (blue-forward, orange minimized to icons + tab underline) is complete. If further iterations focus on new sections/features, consider adding wrapper-level data-testid on ambassadors/adventure-cta/experts/testimonials/destinations/footer for cleaner selection.
